training.label: Building training
training.note: Building specific training from the ETB. One leader on every club night must hold it. Events are away from the building and do not need one.

sections.name: Club night
sections._dates: Fridays to mid December. Past nights drop off the rota by themselves. Add more here as BOETC confirms them, or set day to a weekday name to fill the next eight weeks automatically instead.
